collapse_declaration: Three-group PMMA (C5H8O2, rho = 1.19 g/cm3) data declared for the FiR 1 cylindrical-phantom depth-profile check on the measured PMMA phantom (TECDOC-1223 FIG. 3). Group boundaries match the declared beam histogram bins (fast 1e4-1.69e7 eV, epithermal 0.5-1e4 eV, thermal 1e-5-0.5 eV). H1/C12/O16 pointwise sigma_s and sigma_a evaluated from the processed ENDF/B-VIII.1 294K library (the same library the OpenMC validation run consumed) at representative group energies 0.0253 eV / ~70 eV / ~1.3 MeV. Within-group self-scatter carries the elastic component; downscatter removal g0->g1 and g1->g2 follows the Fermi slowing-down estimate xi_bar*Sigma_s/Delta_u (xi_H=1, xi_C=0.158, xi_O=0.12). Upscatter neglected by declaration. The boron dose response is the 10B(n,a) kerma coefficient at a notional dilute 10 ug/g loading basis — a folding convention, not phantom composition. Declared research fixture, not an evaluation-derived library.
